entry.title: Market brief — 23 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: the exchanges were closed on Tuesday 24 November 2026 for Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev, so this entry carries the last session's levels, Monday 23 November 2026, when the Nifty 50 closed at 25,349.65 (-450.95, -1.75%) and the Sensex at 82,435.99 (-1,483.72, -1.77%). The rupee settled at 92.92 per dollar (provisional) and IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,25,123 per 10 g (+₹1,539) and 999 silver at ₹1,52,941 per kg (+₹2,291). Every figure was re-verified on 24 November against two independent sources dated 23 November 2026. The next session is Wednesday 25 November 2026. Education, not advice.
